title: Window Measures Generalization
description: Rename window options to window measures; add read-only measure kinds; update Window/UIWindowKindDefinition/UICanvas and board play + e2e selectors.
summary: Renamed UIWindowOption→UIWindowMeasure, options→measures on UIWindowKindDefinition, Window prop measures, overlay slots window-measures-overlay/stack/stack-inner, float window-measure-float. UIWindowOptionsRail→UIWindowMeasures. Added measure kinds display (ReactNode) and reading (string, optional monospace). Combobox measure uses choices[] (maps to Combobox options prop). Board play uses measures + measuresForPane; Playwright targets window-measures-overlay.
